content.prompt:
Solve each of these equations for $0\le x<360^{\circ}$ to the nearest degree.

You will need to enter the inverse trigonometric function into a calculator.

answer.worked:

answer.worked:
On the unit circle, cosine is the horizontal coordinate. It is zero at the top and bottom of the circle.
$$\begin{align*}x&=90^{\circ}\text{ or }270^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}A&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)\\A&=60^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Sine is negative in Q3 and Q4.
$$\begin{align*}x&=180^{\circ}+60^{\circ}\\x&=240^{\circ}\\x&=360^{\circ}-60^{\circ}\\x&=300^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}A&=\cos^{-1}(0.191)\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}A&=\tan^{-1}(1)\\A&=45^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Tangent is positive in Q1 and Q3.
$$\begin{align*}x&=45^{\circ}\\x&=180^{\circ}+45^{\circ}\\x&=225^{\circ}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\frac{1}{\cos x}&=\sqrt{2}\\1&=\sqrt{2}\cos x\\\cos x&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\\A&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)\\A&=45^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Cosine is positive in Q1 and Q4.
$$\begin{align*}x&=45^{\circ}\\x&=360^{\circ}-45^{\circ}\\x&=315^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
